hook: The AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay. You wanted a bullet point.
caption:
The AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay. You wanted a bullet point.

This isn't an AI problem. It's a calibration problem.

Most people don't realize that ChatGPT, Claude, whatever — they're not reading your mind. They're pattern-matching to the most average version of what someone might want.

And the most average person apparently wants:
→ A warm intro paragraph
→ Three to five "key points"
→ A conclusion that restates everything you just read
→ An offer to "dive deeper" into any section

If that's your style? Great. You're eating well out here.

But if you're someone who thinks in fragments, or needs the bottom line first, or hates when AI talks to you like a LinkedIn post — you're rewriting every single response. Every. Single. Time.

That's the tax you pay for using a tool that doesn't know how you think.

bootfile.ai builds a profile of your actual thinking style — how you process info, what formats click for you, how much context you need before you make a decision — and turns it into instructions the AI actually uses.

No more reformatting. No more "can you make this shorter and less formal."

Just answers that sound like they were made for you. Because they were.
